android.desc:
Assindo is an AI phone assistant. It answers your calls like a receptionist, screens callers, and makes calls for you, so you stop losing time to the phone.

AI RECEPTIONIST FOR YOUR INCOMING CALLS
- Answers calls you miss or decline, in a natural voice.
- Screens callers, collects their name and reason for calling, and takes a message like a voicemail that talks back.
- Sends you a transcript and a short summary of every call.
- Turns each conversation into a task you can follow up on.
- Works well as a call screening assistant for unknown numbers and as a simple answering service for small businesses.

AI CALL ASSISTANT FOR YOUR OUTGOING CALLS
- Calls businesses for you: book appointments, reschedule, ask questions, or contact customer support.
- Navigates phone menus and waits on hold so you don't have to.
- Reports back with the outcome and the full transcript.

MORE THAN CALLS
- Chat with your assistant and follow every task in the app, with live updates and comments.
- Research, scheduling and local business search.
- Generate and publish posts for X (Twitter) and LinkedIn.
- Pick from several assistant personas and set the language your assistant speaks.

WHY ASSINDO
Spam calls, missed calls, voicemail, hold music and appointment phone tag take hours. Assindo handles the small stuff on the phone so you can focus on what matters. Plans and prices are shown in the app before you subscribe, and some plans include a free trial.

Download Assindo and let your AI assistant take the next call.

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I created Assindo, an AI virtual assistant in MVP stage to automate phone calls for busy professionals and parents. Balancing work with personal responsibilities left me losing time to missed calls, hold times, and scheduling tasks. Hiring a human virtual assistant was costly, so I built Assindo to automate and manage these phone-based tasks, freeing up my focus while ensuring no important call or task slips through the cracks.

### How It Works

- Outgoing Calls: Assindo can schedule appointments, handle customer service calls, and make reservations, navigating IVR menus and managing hold times.
- Incoming Calls: It transcribes messages, summarizes key info, and sets up follow-up tasks – so no critical call is missed.

### Next Steps

I applied to YC 2025 (fingers crossed!) and am looking for early adopters to try Assindo and share feedback, as well as suggestions on new features to improve the experience.

### What is new ?

We have shared that we have launched a web version 2 weeks ago. Today, we are thrilled to share we have released the Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.asindo.beta.prod&hl=en_US. Note: currently available only for the US and Canada.

visit assindo.com for more info. Thanks, and I’d love any feedback!

iOS will be released in few days, you can join the wait list: https://www.assindo.com/waitlist
